## What's new

Possibly the largest update yet, this time I improved the UI in many ways and largely solved UNBEATABLE's offset issue. Enjoy!

- Added a grid view and search bar to the main beatmap list
- Reworked the settings menu to allow for more options in the future.
- The editor can now find the best offset for your charts
  - A new "Detect" button has been added to the export offset input in the Export menu. Check it out for more information!
- Added a save interval option to save charts automatically every few minutes (configurable)
- Added a new "Quick Export" button that you can configure to quickly export or playtest your chart with a single click.
- Improved chart preview in regards to brawl and freestyle notes
- Updated UNANIMATED: Changed the hint for using "|" symbols to ";" semicolons.
- Added new "Package with Folder" export option
- "Export successful!" messages now have a button to open the exported result in the file explorer
- Made Song Length of charts editable
- Fixed the menues at the top of the editor always closing when pressing a toggle button
- Fixed the editor not prompting a save when closing the window

**Happy mapping!**
